constructive_Weyl_family.definition: For an isolated pair-shell momentum k*, take normalized span<=R truncations of the exact proton/pion ground eigenvectors at k*,-k*. Multiply each by an L-site normalized plane-wave box and separate their origins by D=4(L+R+3); apply the native CAR product.
constructive_Weyl_family.exact_full_source_ground_vectors_defined: Isolated ground spectral projections of the confining relative operators; choose any normalized vector in each range at k*. Simplicity or a unique eigenvector is not required.
constructive_Weyl_family.sequence_rule: R tends to infinity, L=2^(4R), D=4(L+R+3); every residual bound tends to zero.
constructive_Weyl_family.tail_recursion: Exact tail <= product_(r=2)^R b/[C+4*kappa*(r-2)/3-E_upper]. Executed upper bounds round outward at32R bits, adding at most R*2^(-32R); the entire relative tail is retained.
constructive_Weyl_family.weak_zero_reason: The antiquark and its right singlet cluster lie beyond D; overlap with every fixed finite occupation vector is eventually zero.
